meta_description_en: Readers' letters in Outlet #131: L.G. Baumann on modifying Tasword II loading on Plus D, Colin Bibby on dumping Icon Graphix screens on ZX Spectrum +3.
meta_description_ru: Письма читателей в Outlet #131: L.G. Baumann о доработке загрузки файлов в Tasword II на Plus D, Colin Bibby о печати экранов из Icon Graphix на ZX Spectrum +3.
body_en_plain:
Jul, 1998  No.131   Page Reply

 How to write to us...02     -

 L.G. Baumann.........03     -

 Colin Bibby..........05     -

 Alan Sharvell........11    14

 Vic Bishop...........15    18

 J. Cameron...........21    23

 Miles Kinloch........24    28

   PLEASE SEND YOUR TEXTFILE!
Text is accepted in any form for
OUTLETTERS: wordprocessor files
(say which),typed or handwritten
letters. However, PLEASE send us
a textfile if possible so your
letter needn't be typed again!
The easiest for us to edit are
Tasword 2 files with the right
margin set at 32 but a textfile
in ANY format is appreciated!

Please state if there should be
parts of your letter you do not
wish published but we always use
our discretion anyway. Letters
may also be edited for clarity
and length... Please ask if you
welcome direct correspondence
from other OUTLET readers and we
will publish your full address.

From: L.G. Baumann


Dear  Mr. Cavers,

To Load a file in Tasword II one
chooses item J on the menu.A CAT
is done automatically and one is
asked to type in the name of the
file to load.

When I moved over to Plus D I
wondered if it would not be
possible to type in the P No.
instead, as being more reliable
(Avoids mis-typing). It was
laughably easy and I sent the
alteration to a magazine. That
was about 7 years ago but would
perhaps still be new to some
readers of Outlet.


Just change Line 2000 to read...

2000 CLS : CAT md: INPUT "No. of
File to Load? ";z: LOAD Pz: GO
TO 1

Remember to Enter the Number
only (wihout the P)


         L.G. Baumann

From: Colin Bibby, MANCHESTER

        ICON GRAPHIX art

A couple or more hints on this
brill proggy shortly but first
I'd like to mention once again
my request for an interface SI-1
and the `10+ reward offer. If
anyone can dig me out one of
these interfaces then let's talk
dosh as soon as possible.

          ICON GRAPHIX

My apologies for the delay here
in replying to a query from one
of the Outlet readers a couple
of issues back. BUSY. The query
concerned getting the +3 hard
copy from I G screen$.


Before explaining the solution I
will tell you that a tutor page
is now available from myself for
this proggy which seems to me to
be the greatest ever for the ZX.
Well, that's my opinion and I'm
sticking with it.

This tutor page is organised and
produced on coloured paper via
outside duplication services.
Therefore,to receive a copy just
send me TWO stamps. ONE FOR MY-
SELF TO HELP COVER MY COSTS. The
other to return your copy.

This single douple sided copy is
quite thorough, explaining well
how to use all IG functions with
both +2A and +3 systems.You just
ain't going to use this magnifi-
cent software without it.

As stated by that earlier chap,
we can obtain hard copy from the
earlier grey +2 dumping to such
as the Alphacom thermal printer.
This print/dump icon remains in-
operative with both the +2A & +3
systems.To skip round this +2A+3
problem ACTivate the LOAD/SAVE
icon 1st.

Using the ramdisc SAVE M : 1 but
without including the " " excla-
mation marks at this point.
I will leave it to you to work
out filenames of choice. 1-2-3
etc are probably faves for a
number of reasons & up to 8 max
in ram storage. If probs exper-
ienced inserting filenames at
LOAD/SAVE try the right curs on
left of space bar a few times to
rectify probs.

Your piccy now stored in "M", we
now need to break into Basic.

Press Q to "Q"uit into Basic and
take care not to press enter.

This Q operation will probably
bring you to the +3 Basic line:-

  L BREAK into program, 222:1

I can't remember if the tape
original copy does likewise. The
Q move might take you straight
to Basic if loaded from tape. My
disccopy brings that Basic line
mentioned above. Next I need to
press space once only which then
brings me to the +3 initial menu
screen. From here we need to
bring down the highlighter onto
+3 Basic then enter it.

Press enter a 2nd time just to
ensure the cursor is at home on
left of screen resting between
bas lines 1 & 2.

THIS TIME USING " " QUOTE MARKS
and with printer ON and loaded
with paper For hardcopy simply
type:-

LOAD "M : 1" SCREEN$ : COPY

       ...then enter it. For two
copies use : COPY : COPY. I will
leave it to you to work out how
to obtain more copies.

When satisfied and ready to go
back into IG type:-

GOTO 100 (not GO TO 100) then
enter it.

Remember that your screen$ are
still held in RAM and therefore
still available for any necess-
ary alterations by simply ACTiv-
ating the LOAD/SAVE icon then
once again without using the " "
mark LOAD M : 1 etc etc.

In fact, all those brill and
fascinating functions of IG
which don't +3 work - DO. So:-
To earn that tenner reward or
receive a copy of my IG tutor
(TWO stamps for the latter is a
must), send to...

            C. BIBBY
        2 MOORCROFT ROAD
         NORTHERN MOOR
          WYTHENSHAWE
           MANCHESTER
            M23 0WJ

From: Alan Sharvell, HARROW






Dear Brian & Ron,

With reference to PC Issue 50
(May, 98) I notice that there
was an article on the Spectrum
emulators which covers tapes
etc, for running through the PC.
It was all very interesting but
I am still awaiting the anwer to
running 3.5" disks (+3 not +D)
which was promised some time ago
by all the wiz kids who did the
emulators.

I have asked most of my friends
and have also seen articles
promising the converion for the
+3 but so far no joy. There were
quit a few +3 owners out there
who, like me, would lke to be
able to just bung a 3.5" disk in
and run it.


After all,it means that a lot of
the personal letters are now
just a dusty disk or two. I men-
tioned to Brian Gaff that I had
no desire to add a cassette
player to the PC but,once again,
no joy. Even the CD containing
3000 games etc, did not include
the interesting bits from the +3
days.


I am surprised that Dominic
Morris did not have a go at that
after he ironed out the bugs in
his +D convertor but I guess
that he also flogged off his +3
gear in favour of the PC. So,
if any readers have any ideas on
running +3 programs, I would be
grateful for the info but I
don't want to get the +3 out of
the loft to do it PLEASE.

            Cheers,

             Alan Sharvell

Ron Cavers to Alan Sharvell

Sorry,we've still heard nothing
on the Plus 3 emulator front. It
is not even clear whether this
project has progressed any fur-
ther than the idea - after all,
it is a major project for some-
one. Still, we'll keep our eyes
and ears open and if we get any
news at alll, we'll let you know


                         Ron

From: Vic Bishop, LANCS

Dear Brian,

I have recently bought a second
hand CITIZEN ABC Colour printer
complete with colour interface
and ribbons (plus instruction
manual.Also included are drivers
for the Amiga and Windows 3.1

It is excellent as a printer for
single sheets black & white, but
the drivers are not compatible
with my Spectrum 128. I assume
that if one could load the driv-
er into an Amiga then the codes
could be altered to suit the
spectrum. In any event I lack
the expertise to do it. I really
would like to use the colour
side.

Do you have any suggestions(oth-
er than 'BIN IT'?) I would be
grateful for any help from any
source. I can supply the Amiga
or Windows driver. I'm further
frustrated without a tractor
feed.

I am also having a problem with
the program Print Options in
Outlet No 129. It loads OK in 48
mode and runs until I enter the
program, ie: set the code wanted
then press L to load the program
which requests the drive no -
normally 1. It then asks the
program name.

If I remove the Outlet disc and
replace it with Tasword 2 and
ENTER it loads, but on pressing


1 to continue, all that happens
is that rubbish characters app-
ear instead of the proper instr-
uctions. It will work (after a
fashion) if you know the posit-
ion of the letter that you would
normally press. I imagine that
this can be put right " "JUST
LIKE THAT"!!

I still consider Outlet an ex-
cellent buy and look forward to
each month's copy. I am at pres-
ent trying to spend some time on
back issues with good effect. It
is all too easy to look at each
issue, spend a little time on it
with the intention of going back
to it later and never actually
getting round to it. Does that
strike any chords anywhere?
                     Vic Bishop

Brian Cavers to Vic Bishop



Sorry,the PRINTER OPTIONS bug is
our fault. We always add our own
character set: AUTOCHARS (by co-
incidence it is in ADDENDERS in
this issue). TASWORD fills the
space where the AUTOCHARS char-
acters are stored and the Spect-
rum faithfully treats the Tas-
word code as if it were a char-
acter set!

I have corrected this and also
set the colour to the default
black  on white and put the new
PRINTER OPTIONS program in this
issue in ADDENDERS.



If the Citizen printer has an
Epson mode. that is, if it will
accept Epson codes, then you can
use the colour. Check the manual
and/or try this...

POKE @6,1 (+3,FORMAT LPRINT "u")
RESTORE

FOR N=0 TO 6
  READ C$
  LPRINT CHAR$ 27;"r";CHR$(N);
  LPRINT N;" ";C$
NEXT N

DATA "BLACK","MAGENTA","CYAN",
     "VIOLET","YELLOW","RED",
     "GREEN"

If not, you might need to check
if there is some switch to get
to Epson emulation mode.

If it works then you can alter
Tasword 2 so you can insert the
graphic symbols right in the
text to switch colours. This is
described on Page 20 of the Tas2
manual and the top of Page 11
shows how to insert them in the
text file. If you need any help
with this.

Printing colour graphics, eg, a
screen dump needs special soft-
ware. Does anyone know of any
for the Spectrum or have any
info on this printer?

                      Brian

From: J. Cameron, NEWCASTLE



Hello to the Cavers,

Did I get a good bargain at the
boot sale a while back? For 50
pence, I got two rubber-keyed
Spectrums (48k & 16k) without
psu's, a 16k RAM pack, Interface
1 & 2, but specially 2 different
light pens with tapes and
manuals, (Dk'tronics & Datapen
Microtechnology Ltd.).

Although I've only tried the
pens on the old Spectrum, I've
made no attempt to try it on my
+3. Any compatibility problems
over this?


Also I have gotten an OCP Art
package with a mouse, tape and
manuals, I did try this through
the +3, I think with a Kempston
joystick interface? after going
through the menu routine, I only
managed a couple of steps before
the program crashed on me and
never attemted to try again. Any
tips on using this utility and
the light pens on the +3?

I would be appreciated on this.

                Yours,

                J Cameron.

Brian Cavers to J. Cameron

I can't think of any special
reason why the light pens would
not work on the +3 unless the
timing is critical. I'm sure it
cannot do any harm so give it a
go. If it doesn't work you could
try loading in 48K mode just in
case it uses the old printer
buffer area that 128K now uses.

I would try the art program with
no hardware added to start with.
Then, why not try the mouse; it
is far better than a joystick in
an art program.

Has anyone else any of the above
and can help?
                         Brian

From: Miles Kinloch, EDINBURGH

Dear Brian,

I thought you might be interest-
ed to know that I've succeeded
in converting PRINCE OF PERSIA
to run on the +D. This is a game
that really cries out to be on
disk, as tape is simply too awk-
ward and unwieldy for its col-
ossal size.

The Spectrum version, being of
Russian origin, was originally
written for TR-DOS, which made
it incompatible with any other
system. However, the group
PHANTASY then hacked it to work
from cassette, and it was from
this that I developed the +D
version.

It's important to realise it
will only run on a standard +D
fitted with ROM 1a (either G+DOS
or Betados can be used), as the
game is a multi-loader and acc-
esses the drive from machine
code. It also needs a 128K Spec-
trum.


Someone actually sent me this
game before to hack, but as
there was no short-cut way to
access the levels and test the
loading, I was forced at the
time to abandon it. Thankfully,
this version's cheat mode (keys
PHT) for skipping levels
provided the answer to this
problem, otherwise it still
wouldn't have been possible.


That's by far the biggest obst-
acle to converting multi-loaders
I find, for not only do you need
to be a skilful hacker, you have
to be an expert at playing them
as well!

Sadly, I don't have any instr-
uctions for it, and the only
info. I have is an old article
from WOMO's magazine, plus the
text file I was sent with the
cassette version. [Miles has
since written to say that he now
DOES have some instructions -Ed]

In actual fact, I've converted
many tape multi-loader games for
the +D (and some for 128K, when
the levels are short enough all
to fit in the extra memory).


Those I've done so far include..

GAUNTLET 1, GAUNTLET 2, INDIANA
JONES AND THE TEMPLE OF DOOM,
ANCIENT BATTLES 128, CROMWELL,
WARS OF THE ROSES, YES PRIME
MINISTER, ALTERNATIVE WORLD
GAMES, THE KRYPTON FACTOR, BLOCK
BUSTERS, EVERY SECOND COUNTS,
ROAD RUNNER, PINK PANTHER,
SNODGITS, AGENT X and HEROES OF
THE LANCE.

I'd be willing to give these to
anyone who was interested, prov-
ided they supplied proof that
they owned the original game.
Again, however, I must emphasise
that the majority work only with
+D/ROM 1a and are NOT compatible
with Unidos, Disciple etc.
                  Miles Kinloch

Brian Cavers to Miles Kinloch

Thanks, Miles. I had the SAM
version of Prince of Persia and
thoroughly enjoyed it. I even
finished it - which was extra
difficult on the SAM compared to
the PC version because there was
NO save game position feature! -
you had to play it straight
through in one go!

It's a real classic. I first saw
it at a Microfair and stared in
awe at the lifelike animation of
the main character. Good one.

Where can readers buy a copy? Is
it from Fountain PD? It's not
clear from the stuff you sent.
                        Brian.

Для загрузки файла в Tasword II выбирается пункт J в меню. CAT выполняется автоматически, и вас просят ввести имя файла для загрузки.

Когда я перешел на Plus D, я задался вопросом, нельзя ли вместо этого вводить номер файла (P No.), так как это надежнее (избегает опечаток). Это было смехотворно просто, и я отправил это изменение в журнал. Это было около 7 лет назад, но, возможно, это все еще будет новостью для некоторых читателей Outlet.

Просто измените строку 2000, чтобы она выглядела так:

```text
2000 CLS : CAT md: INPUT "No. of
File to Load? ";z: LOAD Pz: GO
TO 1
```

Не забудьте вводить только число (без P).

L.G. Baumann

**От: Colin Bibby, MANCHESTER**

**Арт ICON GRAPHIX**

Пара или больше советов по этой замечательной программе скоро будут, но сначала я хотел бы еще раз упомянуть свою просьбу об интерфейсе SI-1 и вознаграждении в 10 фунтов. Если кто-то может найти мне один из этих интерфейсов, давайте договоримся о цене как можно скорее.

**ICON GRAPHIX**

Приношу свои извинения за задержку с ответом на вопрос одного из читателей Outlet пару выпусков назад. Был ЗАНЯТ. Вопрос касался получения твердой копии (распечатки) с экрана I G на +3.

Прежде чем объяснять решение, скажу, что теперь у меня доступна страница с учебным пособием по этой программе, которая, как мне кажется, является лучшей из когда-либо созданных для ZX. Ну, это мое мнение, и я придерживаюсь его.

Эта страница пособия организована и напечатана на цветной бумаге с помощью сторонних копировальных услуг. Поэтому, чтобы получить копию, просто пришлите мне ДВЕ марки. ОДНУ ДЛЯ МЕНЯ, ЧТОБЫ ПОКРЫТЬ МОИ РАСХОДЫ. Другую — чтобы вернуть вам копию.

Эта одностраничная двусторонняя копия довольно подробна и хорошо объясняет, как использовать все функции IG с системами +2A и +3. Вы просто не сможете использовать это великолепное программное обеспечение без него.

Как уже упоминал тот парень ранее, мы можем получить твердую копию с более раннего серого +2, сбрасывая на такие принтеры, как Alphacom. Этот значок печати/дампа остается нерабочим с системами +2A и +3. Чтобы обойти эту проблему +2A/+3, сначала активируйте значок LOAD/SAVE.

Используя ramdisc SAVE M : 1, но без включения восклицательных знаков " " в этот момент. Я оставлю вам возможность самим придумать имена файлов. 1-2-3 и т.д., вероятно, являются предпочтительными по ряду причин, и до 8 максимально в оперативной памяти. Если возникнут проблемы при вставке имен файлов в LOAD/SAVE, попробуйте несколько раз нажать правый курсор слева от клавиши пробела, чтобы исправить проблемы.

Ваша картинка теперь сохранена в "M", теперь нам нужно выйти в Basic.

Нажмите Q, чтобы выйти ("Q"uit) в Basic, и будьте осторожны, не нажимайте Enter.

Эта операция Q, вероятно, приведет вас к строке Basic на +3:

`L BREAK into program, 222:1`

Я не помню, делает ли оригинальная копия на кассете то же самое. Переход Q может сразу перенести вас в Basic, если загрузка шла с кассеты. Моя дисковая копия выдает строку Basic, упомянутую выше. Далее мне нужно нажать пробел только один раз, что затем вернет меня к начальному меню +3. Отсюда нам нужно переместить подсветку на +3 Basic, а затем войти в него.

Нажмите Enter второй раз, просто чтобы убедиться, что курсор находится в исходном положении слева экрана между строками Basic 1 и 2.

В ЭТОТ РАЗ ИСПОЛЬЗУЯ КАВЫЧКИ " ", при включенном принтере и загруженной бумаге, для твердой копии просто введите:

`LOAD "M : 1" SCREEN$ : COPY`

...затем нажмите Enter. Для двух копий используйте `: COPY : COPY`. Я оставлю вам возможность самим разобраться, как получить больше копий.

Когда вы будете довольны и готовы вернуться в IG, введите:

`GOTO 100` (не `GO TO 100`), затем нажмите Enter.

Помните, что ваши screen$ все еще хранятся в RAM и поэтому все еще доступны для любых необходимых изменений: просто активируйте значок LOAD/SAVE, а затем снова, не используя кавычки " ", введите `LOAD M : 1` и так далее.

Фактически, все те блестящие и захватывающие функции IG, которые не работают на +3, начинают работать. Итак: чтобы получить это вознаграждение в десять фунтов или получить копию моего пособия по IG (ДВЕ марки для последнего обязательны), присылайте на...

C. BIBBY
2 MOORCROFT ROAD
NORTHERN MOOR
WYTHENSHAWE
MANCHESTER
M23 0WJ

Есть ли у кого-нибудь что-то из вышеперечисленного, и можете ли вы помочь?
Brian

### От: Miles Kinloch, EDINBURGH

Дорогой Brian,

Подумал, тебе будет интересно узнать, что мне удалось адаптировать PRINCE OF PERSIA для работы на +D. Это игра, которая буквально умоляет перенести её на диск, поскольку кассета для её колоссального размера просто слишком неудобна и громоздка.

Спектрумовская версия, будучи российского происхождения, изначально была написана для TR-DOS, что делало её несовместимой с любой другой системой. Однако группа PHANTASY затем взломала её для работы с кассеты, и именно на её основе я разработал версию для +D.

Важно понимать, что она будет работать только на стандартном +D с установленным ROM 1a (можно использовать как G+DOS, так и Betados), поскольку игра является мультилоадером и обращается к дисководу из машинного кода. Для неё также требуется 128K Spectrum.

Вообще-то мне уже присылали эту игру на взлом раньше, но так как не было быстрого способа переходить по уровням и проверять загрузку, мне пришлось на тот момент бросить эту затею. К счастью, встроенный в эту версию чит-режим (клавиши PHT) для пропуска уровней помог решить проблему, иначе это всё ещё было бы невозможно.

По моим наблюдениям, это безусловно самое большое препятствие при конверсии мультилоадеров: ведь нужно быть не просто умелым хакером, но ещё и экспертом по прохождению этих игр!

К сожалению, у меня нет к ней инструкций, и вся имеющаяся информация — это старая статья из журнала WOMO да текстовый файл, который мне прислали вместе с кассетной версией. [С тех пор Miles написал, что теперь у него ЕСТЬ кое-какие инструкции. — Прим. ред.]

На самом деле я перевёл на +D множество кассетных мультилоадеров (а некоторые и под 128K, когда уровни достаточно короткие, чтобы целиком уместиться в дополнительной памяти).

Среди тех, что я уже сделал:

GAUNTLET 1, GAUNTLET 2, INDIANA JONES AND THE TEMPLE OF DOOM, ANCIENT BATTLES 128, CROMWELL, WARS OF THE ROSES, YES PRIME MINISTER, ALTERNATIVE WORLD GAMES, THE KRYPTON FACTOR, BLOCK BUSTERS, EVERY SECOND COUNTS, ROAD RUNNER, PINK PANTHER, SNODGITS, AGENT X и HEROES OF THE LANCE.

Я был бы рад предоставить их любому заинтересованному лицу при условии, что он предоставит доказательство владения оригинальной игрой. Однако снова вынужден подчеркнуть, что большинство из них работает только с +D/ROM 1a и НЕ совместимо с Unidos, Disciple и т. д.
Miles Kinloch
